data.name: GDR1_001
data.value: Hold on...[pause=0] You're not {0}...

data.name: GDR1_002
data.value: Who are you?[pause=0] Only guild members are supposed to be up here on the top floor.

data.name: GDR1_003
data.value: But either way,[pause=10] we're allowed to be up here!

data.name: GDR1_004
data.value: We just joined the guild earlier today!

data.name: GDR1_005
data.value: Oh,[pause=10] alright.[pause=0] I didn't realize we had new recruits today.

data.name: GDR1_006
data.value: Well,[pause=10] welcome to the guild.[pause=0] You'd better not be here to steal snacks either!

data.name: GDR1_007
data.value: No no![pause=0] We didn't even know there was food in here before we walked in!

data.name: GDR1_008
data.value: Oh.[pause=0] Sorry.[pause=0] I'm a bit on edge because {0} keeps trying to sneak food after dinner.

data.name: GDR1_009
data.value: If he's so hungry,[pause=10] he should just eat more at dinner![pause=0] I can't stand him sometimes!

data.name: GDR1_010
data.value: Does he not like my meals or something!?

data.name: GDR1_011
data.value: Well,[pause=10] whatever.[pause=0] No use getting too worked up about it...

data.name: GDR1_012
data.value: So,[pause=10] um...[pause=0] Is this the dining room?

data.name: GDR1_013
data.value: That's right.[pause=0] This is where we guild members have our meals.

data.name: GDR1_014
data.value: I'm the chef,[pause=10] {0}.[pause=0] I cook all the delicious meals that the guild gets to enjoy.

data.name: GDR1_015
data.value: I was so worked up before that I forgot to ask your names.[pause=0] What are they,[pause=10] my future connoisseurs?

data.name: GDR1_016
data.value: My name is {0},[pause=10] and my friend here is {1}.

data.name: GDR1_017
data.value: {0}...[pause=0] {1}...[pause=0]. Welcome again to the guild.

data.name: GDR1_018
data.value: You know...[pause=0] You're both very lucky to join a guild with such a great chef~

data.name: GDR1_019
data.value: Just wait until you get a taste of some of my specialties. {0}

data.name: GDR1_020
data.value: Kebia pit covered in a Babiri paste...

data.name: GDR1_021
data.value: Pickled Chartis with a Wacan sauce...

data.name: GDR1_022
data.value: I've even been working on a dish using Jaboca and Rowap berries.[pause=0] Some real high-class delicacies~

data.name: GDR1_023
data.value: Of course,[pause=10] the meals I'd like to prepare,[pause=10] like the ones I just told you,[pause=10] require exotic ingredients...

data.name: GDR1_024
data.value: But it's hard to find those sorts of delicacies,[pause=10] and the Guildmaster only stocks basic provisions...

data.name: GDR1_025
data.value: So I typically only get to make more plebian meals...

data.name: GDR1_026
data.value: Of course,[pause=10] I can still make excellent meals even with the basics.

data.name: GDR1_027
data.value: I can make all sorts of things with Orans,[pause=10] Leppas,[pause=10] and Apples.[pause=0] I'm just that talented. {0}

data.name: GDR1_028
data.value: (Oh thank goodness...[pause=0] You can't go wrong with those at least.)

data.name: GDR1_029
data.value: Sounds like you're a great chef![pause=0] I can't wait to have some of your food tomorrow!

data.name: GDR1_030
data.value: Tomorrow's meal won't be my best work because of the ingredients...

data.name: GDR1_031
data.value: But I'm sure with my skill and talent you'll enjoy it nonetheless.

data.name: GDR1_032
data.value: I'm looking forward to the day you get to enjoy a truly exquisite meal using the finest ingredients. {0}

data.name: GDR1_033
data.value: Hey {0}...[pause=0] It's getting pretty late...

data.name: GDR1_034
data.value: We should head back to our room and hit the hay for the night.

data.name: GDR1_035
data.value: Let's head there whenever you're ready,[pause=10] {0}.

data.name: GDR1_036
data.value: But I'm sure with my skill and talent you'll enjoy it nonetheless.

data.name: GDR1_037
data.value: I'm looking forward to the day you get to enjoy a truly exquisite meal using the finest ingredients. {0}

data.name: GDR1_038
data.value: Oh,[pause=10] really?[pause=0] We didn't know that.

data.name: GDR1_039
data.value: We're exploring different rooms to say hello to everyone.

data.name: GDR1_040
data.value: Err...[pause=0] Yeah,[pause=10] those do sound quite...[pause=0] appetizing...

data.name: GDR1_041
data.value: (None of those sound any good...[pause=0] I don't even think I've heard of some of those berries before...)

data.name: GDR1_042
data.value: It's good to see you can recognize my talent as a chef. {0}
